text:
Type: tufted woven cotton throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, modern, farmhouse
Materials: woven cotton, raised tufted loops, textured weave
Colors: black, white
Shape: square, horizontal bands of checks with rows of chunky black tufted blocks and a rope stitch line, knife edges, compact
Feel: tactile, graphic, cozy
Goes with: white or grey sofas, natural wood, black and white decor; bohemian or modern farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern 100% Cotton Tufted Contrast Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Black White
product.description: Tufts of square Black yarn add a three-dimensional look and feel to this modern high-contrast pillow. A reverse side of solid Black gives you an alternative look, and the pillow can be thrown in the wash for convenient cleaning. 17" x 17" 100 % Cotton Polyester fiber-filled insert included Made in india Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
